title: Free granny square slippers pattern (Granny square 1)
author: Simply Yarn (Simply Crochet)
notes: Granny square 1 of the slipper pattern only; already starts with a magic loop; "Round N (RS)" headings normalised to "Round N:"; the "Join <colour> into final ch-2 sp." lines between rounds omitted (the "[8 3-tr groups]" count printed on the join line after Round 2 is dropped with it); DSL has no colour annotations; Round 4 "Ch3, (3tr, ch1) into ch-2 sp" transcribed literally (gives 4 tr in the first group); making-up/joining omitted
